skill.name: slack-gif-creator
skill.description: Create animated GIFs optimized for Slack messages and custom emoji. The toolkit includes validators, GIF assembly, animation templates, drawing helpers, effects, and optimization guidance.
skill.summary: Create and validate Slack-ready GIFs with reusable animation primitives.

content.value_statement: Slack GIFs must meet strict size and dimension limits. This skill helps create, optimize, and validate animated GIFs for messages and custom emoji.
actual_capabilities: Generate animated GIF frames with templates for shake, bounce, spin, pulse, fade, zoom, explode, wiggle, slide, flip, morph, move, and kaleidoscope.
Validate GIF size and dimensions against Slack message and emoji constraints.
Save GIFs with color quantization, duplicate frame removal, and emoji-focused optimization.
Draw text, emoji, shapes, shadows, gradients, particles, impact flashes, and shockwave rings.
Provide reusable Python examples for composing multi-phase Slack animations.
Support color palettes and typography helpers for readable reaction GIFs.
limitations: Requires Python dependencies such as Pillow, imageio, imageio-ffmpeg, and numpy.
Does not upload files to Slack or manage workspace permissions.
Very complex emoji GIFs may not fit within the 64KB Slack limit.
Emoji rendering depends on fonts available in the local runtime.

use_cases.title: Create team reaction emoji
use_cases.description: Build small animated emoji for internal Slack reactions, then validate dimensions and file size.

use_cases.title: Design launch announcement GIFs
use_cases.description: Create polished message GIFs with motion, text, color palettes, and final optimization for Slack sharing.

use_cases.title: Prototype animation concepts
use_cases.description: Combine reusable primitives to test motion ideas before producing a final Slack-ready GIF.

prompt_templates.title: Make a simple emoji GIF
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a small custom Slack emoji.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 128x128 Slack emoji GIF of a smiling sun pulsing twice. Keep it under 64KB and validate the file size.

prompt_templates.title: Create a message reaction GIF
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a Slack message animation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 480x480 Slack message GIF where a rocket slides in, bounces, and flashes on impact. Optimize for under 2MB.

prompt_templates.title: Combine multiple effects
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a composed reaction animation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a custom reaction GIF that morphs from surprised to relieved. Use clean colors, outlined text, and Slack-ready validation.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a full animation workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert request for a multi-phase Slack GIF and optimization review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a complex team celebration GIF with three animation phases, particles, text, and a final emoji version. Explain optimization tradeoffs.

output_examples.input: Make a small Slack emoji where a party popper wiggles.
output_examples.output: A short 128x128 emoji GIF plan with wiggle motion, simplified colors, 10 to 12 frames, and validation against the Slack 64KB limit.

output_examples.input: Make a goal celebration GIF for a Slack message.
output_examples.output: A 480x480 animation concept with a falling ball, impact flash, GOAL text, color reduction, and a final size check.

output_examples.input: Turn a boring OK message into an animated Slack reaction.
output_examples.output: A pulsing text-and-emoji reaction with outlined lettering, restrained effects, optimized colors, and Slack readiness checks.

best_practices: Validate early and repeat validation after every major animation change.
Use fewer frames and colors when building custom Slack emoji.
Compose simple phases before adding text, particles, or impact effects.
anti_patterns: Do not assume a complex emoji GIF will fit under 64KB.
Do not rely on gradients or many colors for small emoji files.
Do not skip final validation before sharing the GIF in Slack.

faq.question: Does it upload GIFs to Slack?
faq.answer: No. It creates and validates GIF files. You upload them with your normal Slack workflow.

faq.question: Can it make custom emoji GIFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes emoji-focused dimensions, color limits, frame reduction, and 64KB validation guidance.

faq.question: What dependencies are required?
faq.answer: It uses Python libraries such as Pillow, imageio, imageio-ffmpeg, and numpy.

faq.question: Can I combine multiple animation effects?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill uses reusable primitives that can be mixed into custom animation phases.

faq.question: Will every emoji GIF pass Slack limits?
faq.answer: No. Complex artwork may exceed 64KB. Reduce frames, dimensions, colors, or effects when needed.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows that can run or adapt the Python toolkit.
